posts.headline:
MANIPURI MUSICIAN VIKRAM SINGH DILLI MEIN MARA GAYA:
7 ARRESTED, NORTHEAST COMMUNITY MEIN AAKROSH!
posts.subheadline: 54-saal ke guitarist Chongtham Vikram Singh ko Delhi ke Kilokari area mein peet-peet kar maara gaya. 7 logon ne group assault kiya. Northeast India community ne racial hate crime ka arop lagaaya.
posts.caption: Justice Demand: Delhi mein Manipuri musician Chongtham Vikram Singh ki brutal murder ne poore desh ko hila diya! Northeast community mein bhari outrage! September 6, 2026 ki raat Delhi ke Kilokari area mein ek harrowing incident hua. 54 saal ke renowned Manipuri guitarist aur music teacher Chongtham Vikram Singh, jo 20+ saal se Delhi mein reh rahe the, apne ghar ke bahar noise kar rahe logon ko rokne nikle. Iske baad ek mob ne unhe chase karke brutally assault kiya. Serious injuries se unki maut Holy Family Hospital mein ho gayi. Delhi Police ne 7 log aur ek juvenile arrest kiya hai. Northeast India community ne ise direct racial hate crime kaha aur 2014 ke Nido Taniam murder case se compare kiya. National outrage aur justice demand tez ho gayi hai. Kya Dilli mein Northeast ke log safe hain? Comment karein! Source: Al Jazeera & NDTV #justiceforvikram #northeastindia #delhicrime #hatecrime #indianpolitics

posts.headline:
DELHI SATYA NIKETAN PG BUILDING DAHI:
7 MAUT, HC NE MCD KO 1 HAFTE MEIN AUDIT ORDER!
posts.subheadline: 5-manzila illegal PG building raat ko dheri ho gayi. 7 logon ki maut, kai zakhmi. HC ne MCD ke 5 officers suspend kiye. Supreme Court Sep 10 ko sunwai karega.
posts.highlighted_fact: 7 Dead | 5 MCD Officers Suspended | HC Order
posts.caption: Delhi Building Collapse: Satya Niketan mein 5-manzila PG hostel giri, 7 maute - HC ka MCD ko 1 hafte mein safety audit ka strict order! September 6, 2026 ki raat Delhi ke Satya Niketan area mein ek 5-manzila student PG accommodation building dheri ho gayi jisme 7 logon ki maut aur kai ghaayal hue. Investigating agencies ne khulasa kiya ki building mein na column the na beams - sab illegal construction tha. MCD ne apne hi 5 officers suspend kiye jinmein Deputy Commissioner bhi shamil hain. Building owner Hariram Gupta (81) aur unki wife 14-day judicial custody mein hain. Delhi High Court ne MCD ko ek hafte mein Delhi ke sabhi PG hostels ka emergency safety audit karne ka order diya. Supreme Court September 10 ko is maamle ki sunwai karega. Aapke shahar mein bhi aisi illegal buildings hain? Comment karein! Source: The Hindu & NDTV #delhitrauma #buildingcollapse #mcd #delhi #breakingnews

posts.headline:
MODI KA BHARAT KO MEGA GIFT:
RS. 35,000 CR INFRA + 2,843 KM FREIGHT CORRIDOR POORA!
posts.subheadline: PM Modi ne Gujarat-Maharashtra visit mein Western Dedicated Freight Corridor ka poora 2,843 km network desh ko samarpit kiya. Logistics cost ghategee, EXIM exports tez honge.
posts.highlighted_fact: Rs. 35,000 Cr | 2,843 KM Freight Network Complete
posts.caption: Bharat ki Logistics Revolution: PM Modi ne aaj pura 2,843 km Dedicated Freight Corridor nation ko dedicate kiya - Rs. 35,000 crore ke mega projects inaugurate! September 8, 2026 ko PM Narendra Modi ne Gujarat ke Vadodara aur Maharashtra ke Mumbai mein Rs. 35,000 crore se zyada ke development projects inaugurate kiye. Sabse badi uplabdhi hai poore 2,843 km Dedicated Freight Corridor network ka mukammal operationalization. Western DFC ke teeno naye sections New Sanand-Makarpura, Umbergaon-Saphale aur Saphale-JNPT (Rs. 20,700 crore) ab fully operational hain, jisse JNPA port se direct freight rail connectivity milegi. Logistics cost kam hogi, EXIM cargo fast hoga aur Manufacturing sector boost milega. Mumbai mein Global Fintech Fest 2026 bhi inaugurate hua. Kya yeh freight corridor India ki economy badlega? Comment karein! Source: PIB & India Today #freightcorridor #modigovernment #indiainfrastructure #makeinindia #indianeconomy
